title: Even at the Risk: aun a riesgo de, así + subjunctive
goal: Say that you act in spite of a risk with aun a riesgo de, and say "even if" with así + subjunctive.
grammar: aun a riesgo de, así + subjunctive

items: I can use *aun a riesgo de* with an infinitive or with *que* + subjunctive.
I can use *así* + subjunctive to mean "even if".
I can choose the infinitive when the subject does not change.
